description: This file defines URL routing for a Django REST Framework backend, including route registration for viewsets, JWT authentication endpoints, health check, registration, and SSO placeholders.

classes.name: DefaultRouter
classes.description: A router class from Django REST Framework that automatically generates URL patterns for viewsets.

classes.name: TokenRefreshView
classes.description: A view provided by rest_framework_simplejwt for handling JWT token refresh.

classes.name: TokenVerifyView
classes.description: A view provided by rest_framework_simplejwt for handling JWT token verification.

classes.name: UsernameOrEmailTokenObtainPairView
classes.description: Custom view for obtaining JWT tokens with username or email authentication.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Defines a URL pattern that corresponds to a view.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes other URL patterns under a specified URL prefix.
